title: Mulch early
tip: Use mulch soon after planting to conserve moisture and suppress weeds.

title: Clean water daily
tip: Refresh animal water every day to reduce disease risk and improve intake.

title: Water at the roots
tip: Irrigate at the base of the plant to reduce evaporation and disease spread.

title: Test before you fertilize
tip: A soil test helps you apply the right nutrients and avoid waste.

title: Watch the forecast
tip: Plan spraying and transplanting around rain and wind forecasts.

title: Scout weekly
tip: Inspect leaves and stems weekly so pest outbreaks are caught early.

title: Track every expense
tip: Record input and transport costs to understand your true profit margin.
